name: Fevara plc
summary: Fevara plc is an agricultural enterprise with operations spanning the United Kingdom and international markets. Its primary agricultural division focuses on manufacturing and supplying a comprehensive range of animal nutrition products, including feed blocks, mineral supplements, and specialized boluses containing vital trace elements for livestock. These products are distributed under numerous reputable brands such as Crystalyx, Horslyx, SmartLic, Tracesure, and Animax, among others. In addition to its core farming-related activities, the company also maintains interests in financial services, property management, and engineering, alongside the production and distribution of various animal health solutions. Founded in 1831 and headquartered in Carlisle, UK, the company was formerly known as Carr's Group plc until its rebranding to Fevara plc in September 2025.
